startOnlyAfter: BTCI v8.17 archived/full as-of history verified; retain original v8.17 output and do not revise it
hypothesis: Find independently dated market stress and risk appetite factors that can distinguish legitimate macro easing from subsequent big BTC drawdowns, and label early recovery separately from overheat.

factorFamilies.name: Real rates
factorFamilies.sourceControl: FRED/ALFRED exact as-of Sunday, 4w difference, original observation publication clock verification, earliest 2003
factorFamilies.frozenSign: 4w real yield change>0 = real borrowing discount tightening
factorFamilies.authority: Primary Federal Reserve H.15 series; original daily vintages stored only subject to source license

factorFamilies.name: Broad USD
factorFamilies.frozenSign: 4w change>0 = stronger dollar; financial tightening hypothesis
factorFamilies.sourceControl: Federal Reserve H.10 published daily; historical methodology/rebasing changes must be checked 2019 and 2026

factorFamilies.name: Equity systemic volatility
factorFamilies.frozenSign: 4w change>0 and last level> 4w prior = risk stress rising, directional warning conditional on price
factorFamilies.sourceControl: Cboe VIX may be copyright licensed, check archive/redistribution permissions before bulk collection; prefer store hashes/derived features if rights uncertain

factorFamilies.name: Yield curve
factorFamilies.frozenSign: Slope change lower over 4w, AND separately inversion<0 descriptive; inversion not assumed a near-term BTC crash
factorFamilies.sourceControl: Treasury rates H15 and daily vintage lag

factorFamilies.name: Credit stress
factorFamilies.primary: Federal Reserve publicly released bank funding/spread or OFR Financial Stress Index where licensing is explicit
factorFamilies.rejectedForUnlicensedArchive: BAMLH0A0HYM2 ICE BofA OAS now FRED only trailing three years from Apr2026; Moody BAA10Y copyright forbids reuse and archiving without permission
factorFamilies.frozenSign: Independent rise in spread/stress vs previous 4w; do not normalize/rebase without prereg

cryptoFactors: Coin Metrics CapRealUSD (realized cap, MVRV) as-of vintage not proven; current reconstruction is NOT publication-PIT; only research with explicit vintage missing flag
Historical stablecoin circulating supply and BTC direct flows: must archive contemporaneously verifiable issuer releases or raw chain snapshots, avoid retro supplier revisions
Bitcoin derivatives OI, perpetual funding, CME basis, liquidation clusters: instrument-venue lineage starts later than 2010, require archived snapshots and real release timestamps
BTC realized volatility (only from pinned BTC price history) and on-chain volume/UTXO spend, as independent prediction value to price trend not established
scoring: Use v8.17 fixed targets rise/drawdown 13,26,52w without redefining threshold
Test both directional hypotheses (growth, decline) on SAME common-case subperiod
Compare each factor to BTC-only, macro-only, BTC+macro and prior no signal baselines, not just factor-selected percentage
Use lag week0, 1-4w, 5-13w, 14-26w, 27-52w as pre-specified time-to-event bins; no forced minimum median lead
Require counts, false alarms, delta precision AND delta recall, max adverse path, and no re-optimization on already seen cycle
Sources genuinely unavailable on a date => UNKNOWN, never 0. Do not combine correlated NFCI/ANFCI as independent votes.
Protect original raw rights; store only permitted content with SHA and archive data manifest.
validation: All BTCI up to 8.18 remains retrospectively exploratory, no true OOS. Do not activate live signals until separate shadow workflow and observed forward outcomes.
noChanges: No Spot, Futures, NAV, capital, reserve, P&L, Master, Detector, limits, trades

pathRiskAddendum.reason: Signal-date drawdown understates risk after initial rallies; also compute rolling within-forward-path high water mark drawdown, longest underwater weeks and time to first +20/+50/-20/-35 milestone.
pathRiskAddendum.predeclare: At 13/26/52wk horizons calculate (a) min BTC daily close divided by Sunday signal close -1; (b) worst subsequent drawdown from ANY prior daily-close peak since signal Sunday; (c) minimum daily-close return following first +20% move, (d) days from signal to first threshold crossing, right censored. Do NOT replace v8.17 previously frozen outcomes; produce separate v8.18 derived columns and compare both.
pathRiskAddendum.safety: No index value published after original Sunday in predictor feature; future path solely outcomes. No trading.
